sections.overall: Mercedes Mone vs Hazuki was easily match of the night (8.94), and one of the best TV matches so far this year! A breathtaking meeting, full of drama and suspense. Great to see another top match main event collision: Maya World's surprise win over Athena (7.89). These were the two best bouts of the week - refreshing to see some of the women in AEW show what they can do! With Hazuki up to #4 and Maya #6, it will be exciting to see how far these brilliiant new stars will climb.
sections.mens: Surprisingly, there were only two eligible Men's single matches this week. Neither were classics, though it was great to see the return of Zack Sabre Jr., ahead of his match at Forbidden Door. Also returning was Kyle Fletcher, contiuing from where he left off right towards the top of the rankings. Though the 12 man tag match he featured in should have rated higher, given the impressive talent involved.
sections.womens: With a third women's match this week (Kris Statlander vs Mina Shirakawa on Collision), there were actually more women's singles then men's...surely a record?! The Women's side of the Owen Hart Tournament has really been delivering lately and the final with Mercedes and Maya has been well-built. A great story for both women going into this match.  Of course, it would be remiss to mention that Mercedes has reclaimed her #1 spot atop the Women's rankings - back in her much-accustomed place. Will anyone be able to topple her, while she is an active wrestler in AEW?!
sections.menstag: Welcome back to Brodido! As they had such a high rating when they last featured in 2025, they already return at #3. Although their match against Garcia & Moxley was well-below their lofty heights when they were champions, it would great to see them in the mix more moving forward.
sections.womenstag: Rinse and repeat? This division needs some serious time dedicated to it. A real shame as there are so many talented women in AEW who are simply not given the time or reps to show what they can do, despite the focus on the Owen.
sections.trios: Young Bucks & Perry returned, as did The Lethal Twist. This Collision opener was fun but way off what you'd expect involving Matt and Nick (7.13). Still, at least we had a Trios match this week!
